name: Sakura no Serenade
original_name: 桜の哀想曲　－サクラノセレナーデ－
source:
Since we were little, we were always by each other’s side.

In times of sadness, and in times of joy,
indeed, in sickness and in health,
the two of us have shared the same moments together.
In a place much, much closer than friends, even closer than sisters.

Feelings that grow day by day.
A one-sided love kept warm all along.

Third year of high school. University entrance exams are near.
The curtain rises on a hectic third term.
— The relationship between the two begins to change, little by little.

Translated from the official website
